title: TildePrincipalLocalizationTransport
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $N$ an $R$-module and $e:X\cong\operatorname{Spec}R$ an isomorphism of schemes. Let $G=e^*(\widetilde N)$, using restriction along $e$ [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections]. There is an additive equivalence $b:G(X)\cong N$ such that, for every $r\in R$ and $V=e^{-1}D(r)$, there are a ring equivalence $t:\mathcal O_X(V)\cong R_r$ and an additive equivalence $d:G(V)\cong N_r$. The map $t$ sends the pullback to $V$ of each constant $x\in R$ to $x/1$; $d(xs)=t(x)d(s)$ for all section-ring scalars and sections; and $d(s|_V)=b(s)/1$ for every whole-scheme section. The empty open and zero ring are included.

source.place: Tag 01HV (lemma-spec-sheaves) (2),(4),(5); read via the Stacks website

proof.text: Compose restrictAppIso on the whole scheme with tilde.isoTop inverse to obtain b. On each principal open compose restrictAppIso with IsLocalizedModule.iso inverse for tilde.toOpen, obtaining d. The ring equivalence t is appIso inverse composed with IsLocalization.algEquiv to the concrete localization.

The ring map commutes with constants by appLE_appIso_inv. Restriction compatibility is transportSection_res followed by tilde.toOpen_res and iso_symm_apply. For scalars transportSection_smul reduces to an R-linear localization equivalence; equip the concrete localized module with the section-ring action via the canonical ring equivalence, and use linearMap_compatibleSMul to extend R-linearity to the localized ring.

theorem tilde_principalLocalization_transport
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (N : ModuleCat.{u} R)
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (e : X ≅ Spec R) :
    let G := Scheme.Modules.restrict (tilde (R := R) N) e.hom
    ∃ b : G.val.obj (op ⊤) ≃+ N,
      ∀ r : R,
        let V := e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r
        ∃ t : X.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj (op V) ≃+* Localization.Away r,
          (∀ x : R, t ((e.hom.appLE ⊤ V (by simp))
            ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv x)) =
              algebraMap R (Localization.Away r) x) ∧
          ∃ d : G.val.obj (op V) ≃+ LocalizedModule.Away r N,
            (∀ (x : X.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj (op V)) (s : G.val.obj (op V)),
              d (x • s) = t x • d s) ∧
            ∀ s : G.val.obj (op ⊤),
              d (G.val.map V.leTop.op s) = mk (b s) 1
